notes.title: 5/26/2020 update
notes.content:
We've addressed a display issue encountered while playing the game on certain versions of Windows 10 and Steam.

The previous work around was running the game under compatibility mode, but this update should enable it to run normally.

Just let the game auto-update itself to apply.
